main_question: Does the unconditioned early accessible output depend on a later freely chosen message bit, without filtering on a late herald?

model_definitions.conventional_no_go: Tr_B[(I_A ⊗ E_b)(rho_AB)] = Tr_B(rho_AB) for completely positive trace preserving maps E_b local to late B
model_definitions.postselection_only: Conditional early correlations can differ if a late outcome is selected; the earlier receiver cannot know the late herald.
model_definitions.deutsch_hypothetical: sigma_C = Tr_F[U(rho_F(b) ⊗ sigma_C)U†], for U=SWAP gives sigma_C=rho_F(b), provided the hypothetical CTC resource exists
model_definitions.physical_claim_threshold: Earlier readout must independently reveal newly chosen future message without knowing the message beforehand, receiving forward information, or using postselection. Requires a real, independently authenticated physical interface.
